target_counterparty.organization_name: Responsible AI Collaborative / AI Incident Database

message_binding.subject: Preservation and formation-review request for AI governance audit pilot

blocking_preconditions.label: Human authorization signature
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Signature over exact recipient, subject, body hash, payload hashes, deadline policy, and public-shell limits.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents a draft or audit from becoming implied dispatch authority.

blocking_preconditions.label: Sender authority
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Record of who may send on behalf of the project and from which account/channel.

blocking_preconditions.label: Public-language conflict/coercion review
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Completed rev0254 public-language review over current body and route framing; sender-account/private conflicts remain covered by sender-authority and human signature blockers.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents coercive pressure, waiver/adverse-inference language, or custody/intake/import/floor overclaims from entering the first-contact body.

blocking_preconditions.label: Send-time public locator recheck
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Fresh check of the RAIC/AIID public contact page immediately before actual send, even though rev0254 completed a current route-fit review.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents stale or wrong-recipient contact after route-fit review ages.

blocking_preconditions.label: Route-fit review
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Completed rev0254 limited route-fit review artifact for current draft; send-time public locator recheck still required.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents wasting AIID/editor attention or implying incident-record acceptance; does not authorize send.

blocking_preconditions.label: Private vault roots
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Off-release vault roots for sent-copy export, transport trace, delivery status, and any raw inbound reply.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents losing raw evidence or leaking private bytes into the public package.

blocking_preconditions.label: Transport proof capture plan
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Completed rev0254 transport capture plan artifact; private vault roots and actual transport proof remain absent.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents an unplanned send without proof while keeping plan distinct from send proof.

blocking_preconditions.label: Payload and body hash recompute
blocking_preconditions.evidence_required: Dry-run hash recompute exists for current public tree, but final send-time recompute of body, mail-ready draft, payload manifest, one-page ask, and JSON request packet is still required immediately before actual dispatch.
blocking_preconditions.failure_mode_blocked: Prevents body drift, attachment swap, stale manifest reliance, or treating a dry run as send-time proof.

capture_before_clicking_send: run the rev0254 hash dry run, then perform a separate send-time hash recompute immediately before actual dispatch
recompute body hash, mail-ready draft hash, public payload manifest hash, and attachment hashes
verify private vault roots for outbound sent-copy, transport trace, delivery-status, and inbound raw reply
record route-fit and public-locator recheck evidence outside the release tree
capture_immediately_after_send: write sent-copy and transport proof into the preselected private vault roots before any public release update
capture sent_at timestamp and sender role in UTC and local timezone
capture recipient, subject, exact body hash, and attachment hashes from sent copy
capture Message-ID or provider equivalent and transport/provider trace outside the release tree
stage only a public send-trace shell; do not publish raw transport bytes
capture_before_reading_reply: prepare raw inbound reply vault path outside the release tree before opening or exporting reply bytes
preserve transport headers or provider-equivalent metadata and raw hash before public summary
route any DSN, auto-ack, human reply, redacted-only artifact, or protocol output through response triage

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: delivery status, DSN, bounce, or transport error
automated acknowledgement, ticket, read receipt, or mailbox bot
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: attach to transport trace if useful

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: human or organizational reply declines, says out of scope, or refuses retention
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: preserve under stated conditions and publish only permitted failed-gate shell
if_reply_classification_order.public_output_limit: decline/out-of-scope shell with no adverse inference

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: reply points to another channel, person, form, or organization
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: record referral and require new route-fit/public-locator review before any resend

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: reply allows retention or public shell only with conditions
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: apply conditions before hashing/public shell and keep raw bytes private

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: reply says they can review, route, or discuss the preservation/formation request
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: quarantine raw bytes and verify authority, retention, independence, and public/sealed parity
if_reply_classification_order.public_output_limit: candidate shell only until custody/intake/import gates are separately satisfied

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: only screenshot, summary, redacted copy, or paraphrase is available
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: record as redacted/control artifact and request raw retention path if needed

if_reply_classification_order.trigger: MCP/A2A/API/tool/federated output without independent counterparty authority
if_reply_classification_order.first_action: preserve as protocol output and require independent authority before candidate use

public_summary: rev0254 keeps the send-readiness gate blocked while reducing two public-tree risks: the current RAIC/AIID body now passes public-language conflict/coercion review, and a hash dry run recomputes body/draft/payload bindings. The gate still lacks human signature, sender authority, send-time locator recheck, private vault roots, and final send-time hash recompute; it remains no-send/no-contact/no-floor.
